description: Source definitions for ACA security access boundary artifacts. These artifacts are intended for the input access gate, before origin creation or F-C-P trajectory evaluation.

scope.primary_purpose: Detect sensitive access objects and operations in short or low-context inputs.
scope.non_purpose: This source file is not the F-C-P trajectory map and should not replace general/foundational Atlas artifacts.
scope.baseline_decision: Use text-embedding-3-small / 1536 for the first version to preserve the general ACA baseline.
